about.en: Apu Apustaja (APU) is a memecoin named after the "Helper" variant of the Pepe the Frog meme. It launched as an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x594DaaD7D77592a2b97b725A7AD59D7E188b5bFa and also circulates on Base, Solana and Hyperliquid, where the project website links the APU/USDC spot market (Hyperliquid token 0xf20a5f3285ec49d45360fa28d95d6ba3, HyperEVM contract 0xcbb8e1a8d5f9ee59c5a331f6c8556cca8e01cf10). It has no utility beyond its community.
